_readme: Golden set for Listener's classifiers. Labels are the ground truth the PRD's accuracy targets are measured against. Real examples were taken from live Reddit payment-gateway threads; the 'hard' ones are deliberate edge cases (sarcasm, negation, implicit intent) that a keyword heuristic is expected to miss. Do not delete a failing case to make the score go up: a shrinking golden set is how an eval suite becomes a lie. Add cases when a miss is found in production.
_fields: text, intent (category_intent|competitor_comparison|complaint|brand_mention), sentiment (positive|negative|neutral), hard (true when it needs real NLU)
